name: Release v1.5
body:
# Numo v1.5 🚀
We are excited to announce Numo v1.5! This release is largely built on direct feedback from merchants using Numo on the ground. We are incredibly grateful for your input and will keep listening as we continue to improve. This update focuses heavily on reliability, user experience enhancements, and expanding our support worldwide. 

Here are the major highlights for this update:

### NFC & Payment Reliability
* **Rock Solid NFC:** We've implemented major stability fixes for Tap2Pay. NFC transactions will no longer fail after retries or when resuming the app from the background, ensuring a smooth checkout experience every time.
* **Network Safety Trigger:** Numo now intelligently checks for active internet connectivity. If you're offline, the app will prevent the generation of payment requests to save you and your customers from failed transactions.

### Enhanced History & Analytics
* **Sales Summary:** Gain better insights into your business! A brand new Sales Summary dashboard is now accessible directly from your transaction history.
* **Advanced History Filters:** Easily navigate your past payments with a new expandable filter bar. You can now filter transactions by `Settled` or `Pending` statuses and apply **Custom Date Ranges**.
* **Unified Details & Receipts:** We've merged the receipt screen directly into the transaction details, offering a much cleaner and more seamless experience when reviewing past payments.

### Better Customization
* **Default Payment Methods:** You can now configure your preferred default payment method in the app settings, allowing you to get paid exactly how you want, faster.

### Global Currency & Localization
* **Reliable Exchange Rates via Yadio.io:** We've switched our fiat exchange rate provider from Coinbase to Yadio.io. This change is especially important for LATAM currencies, providing more reliable data and preventing blockages in countries where Coinbase is blacklisted.
* **New Languages:** Numo now fully supports **Korean** and **Japanese** translations! 🇰🇷🇯🇵

---

* feat: Implement network safety trigger for charge buttons and history by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/282

* fix: apply edge-to-edge window insets in TransactionDetailActivity by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/295

* feat: Add Default Payment Method preference by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/297
* feat: Add expandable filter bar to History Activity by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/298
* Change transaction history default filter to 'All' by @a1denvalu3 in https://github.com/cashubtc/Numo/pull/303

name: v1.0
body:
# Numo 🥜⚡ **RELEASE**

![Numo Banner](docs/marketing/readme_banner.png)

Numo is an Android Point-of-Sale application that enables merchants to receive Cashu ecash payments via tap-2-pay.

## Overview

The application acts as a simple point-of-sale terminal for receiving Bitcoin payments. When a customer approaches their phone with a supporting wallet, the app receives the ecash payment.

## How It Works

Using Numo is straightforward:

The merchant enters the desired amount in satoshis using the application's keypad. When they press "Charge", a payment screen appears and a type-4 forum tag is emulated with a cashu PaymentRequest string as its content. When the payer approaches their phone, their Cashu wallet will interact with the emulated tag using the NDEF protocol, reading the contents and decoding the payment request. Immediately after, the paying wallet will write a cashu token with the requested amount to the emulated tag and Numo will process it.

### Numo also supports direct lightning payments
When the merchant switches to the "lightning" tab in the payment screen, a fresh BOLT11 invoice is generated and displayed as a QR code. The contents of the emulated tag are also overwritten with "lightning:<bolt11>", so compatible wallets are be able to scan the BOLT11 invoice from the tag.

## Features

- Tap-2-pay with cashu ecash and NDEF protocol
- Payment through Nostr
- Lightning bolt11 invoices
- Withdraw to self-custody / withdraw to lightning address.
- Automatic withdrawal after threshold is reached
- Merchant item catalogs, with pre-selectable items
- Merchant item baskets, which can be persisted and updated at different times
- Payment history and direct
